description.narrative: Improved socio-economic conditions within and surrounding nature reserves. Stable and progressive increase of visitors of all nature reserves of at least 2% per year Consolidated data base of Lebanese biodiversity

comment.narrative: Total percentage coverage of nature reserves is 3% (2018)

- GIS mapping of protected areas and pipeline including buffer areas - Development/update of Management Plans of all NRs with APAC - Development of a simple GIS based monitoring plan for all PAs - Biodiversity assessment, Analysis and Monitoring plans for all NRs - Implementation of 2 grants to NGOs/CSOs Nature-based inclusive tourism (CfP) in XX nature sites - Development of Sustainable Waste Management plans for XXX protected areas and procurement of needed waste equipment - Scientific Assessment of Research (IC) - Establishment of a buffer zone in Aammiq Wetland (RAMSAR) to reduce highway disturbance through planting of endemic/endangered trees and shrubs - Initiation of an ecosystem services evaluation methodology wth UNESCO - Initiate the development of two mobile applications: tourism and outdoor activities within NRs and fire early warning in protected areas and response protocols - Initiate a business/investment and marketing plans for all NRs with committees - Biodiversity assessment, Analysis and Monitoring plans for all NRs on flora, birds, insects, fauna - Development of Videos, Animations, Postcards for all Nature Reserves - Initiate the provision of grants to NGOs for Community-based solutions: beekeeping - Procurement of NR equipment and material - Initiate the training for forest guards (FAO) (UN to UN Agreement)

- Development/update of Management Plans of 6 NRs with APAC and one RAMSAR site (Aamiq) - Development of a simple GIS based monitoring plan for all PAs - Completed the implementation of 2 grants to NGOs/CSOs Nature-based inclusive tourism (CfP) in 8 nature Reserves - Development of Sustainable Waste Management plans for all (18) Nature Reserves and Biosphere reserves and RAMSAR sites completed - Establishment of a buffer zone in Aammiq Wetland (RAMSAR) to reduce highway disturbance through planting of endemic/endangered trees and shrubs (Completed) - Signed the agreement with UNESCO to undertake ecosystem services evaluation methodology for all Nature Reserves - Initiated the procurement for the Biodiversity assessment, Analysis and Monitoring plans for all NRs on Fauna - Development of Videos, Animations, Postcards for all Nature Reserves (4 videos) - Organized and implemented 4 events (planting and bird watching in Aamiq for world Wetland Day, ToT for the initiation to the all-terrain wheelchair (Chouf and Tannourine), Official launching of the all-terrain wheelchair and inclusive bird watching in Ehden for the World Migratory Bird day) - Completed the design of PV systems for the generation of electricity for the Nature Reserves in Lebanon - Recruited several experts to assist the project in the implementation of the numerous activities/events planned by the project - Requested and was granted a 2 years project extension till October 2024

- Establishment of a baseline assessment for all protected areas covered by the project and completion of an inception report. - Establishment of linkages and working relationships with the relevant central and local actors at the various thematic areas (meetings with relevant ministries and Nature reserves managers and committees), - Coordination with other relevant and ongoing projects for synergies and to avoid duplication and overlapping of activities. - completed of a competitive process for the provision of grants to NGOs/CSOs for nature-based inclusive tourism activities in nature reserves
Project document finalised, and agreement signed with the Donor. Activities will be initiated in 2021 due to delays in receiving the funds.
